'''Aruza''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] orbited by five [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of pale shades of tan, silver, and green. The planet was home to the peaceful [[Aruzan/Legends|Aruzans]], an even-tempered society that abhorred violence. By [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Aruza had not experienced a murder for over one hundred of their years. They were small people with light blue skin and very dark blue hair.

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Aruza was controlled by the [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|COMPNOR]] officer, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Sinick Kritkeen]]. Kritkeen was ordered to "Redesign" the peaceful inhabitants of Aruza into a "viable social force," effectively turning the planet into an efficient war machine, by stripping them of most of their humanity and turning them into vicious servants of Imperial doctrine. If the Aruzans resisted, they were to be "alleviated of the potential for further evolution." The process had impoverished the Aruzans and turned Kritkeen into a very wealthy man. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] destroyed all of the Aruzans' ships to prevent them from escaping the planet. Additionally, an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] orbited the planet.

Wishing to be rid of his fearful reign, the Aruzans hired the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]] to assassinate Kritkeen for the price of 1,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Imperial credits]], a steep price they were willing to pay for their freedom. Although Dengar succeeded in killing Kritkeen, the Empire soon responded by assigning another, more ruthless general to oversee Aruza.

The planet was evacuated by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] sometime between [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] at the request of Dengar. The Rebellion was able to secure an [[Imperial prison barge]], completely staffed, which they assigned to Dengar, posing as an [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] officer. The Rebellion easily forged and sent new orders to Kritkeen's COMPNOR replacement to remove a hundred thousand Aruzans to a "more secure facility."

One notable [[Aruzan/Legends|Aruzan]] was the dancer [[Manaroo/Legends|Manaroo]], who married Dengar. Manaroo's parents were the impetus for Dengar's desire to save the Aruzans from further Imperial subjugation.

Aruza was home to [[rupin tree]]s, [[inderrin tree]]s, [[dola tree]]s, and the creatures known as [[farrow bird]]s and [[bomat]]s.
